patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout with a large, bold text block on a solid background on the left, paired with a full-bleed video on the right.
Dense, multi-column grid layout for displaying detailed performance statistics, where each card presents multiple data points and a prominent score.
Prominent use of a wide, uppercase sans-serif font for main headings and names, creating a strong, athletic brand identity.
High contrast color scheme using a deep navy as the primary background, bright red as a strong accent for key names and numbers, and white for primary text.
The hero section features a full-bleed video background that plays automatically, providing dynamic visual interest upon page load.
Content sections are revealed sequentially as the user scrolls down the page, with no observed complex scroll-triggered animations or sticky elements in the provided sequence.
A dedicated horizontal scrolling section showcases large, captioned images, allowing users to explore different aspects of the athlete's activity without vertical page jumps.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video background to create an immersive and dynamic introduction, with text overlaid on a solid color block for optimal readability.
The site primarily relies on standard vertical scrolling to reveal content sections, presenting information in a clear, linear flow without complex scroll-triggered animations or parallax effects.
A horizontal scrollable component is implemented to display a series of large, captioned images, providing an interactive way to showcase visual content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, wide uppercase headings for names and key metrics (~4-5x body), contrasted with smaller, legible sans-serif text for details and body content.
design_tokens.radius: subtle (small corner radius on cards and buttons, giving a slightly softened edge)
design_tokens.spacing: balanced (airy hero, but content sections like the results grid are dense and information-rich)

standout: This site stands out by combining a dynamic video hero with an exceptionally data-driven presentation of an athlete's career. The dense, detailed performance grids and historical timelines create a compelling, authoritative personal brand experience that goes beyond typical athlete profiles.
